text.p: StreamLogic Corp said it expects to incur $1.0 million in additional restructuring charges over the next two quarters.
The company posted $700,000 in restructuring charges in the third quarter ended December 27 related to consolidation efforts.
For the third quarter ended December 27, StreamLogic earned $0.81 a share after a $1.02 gain on net sales of $11.8 million, compared with a loss of $1.63 a share on net sales of $41.5 million.
The current third quarter gain was due to StreamLogic's exchange offer for its six percent convertible subordinated debentures.

StreamLogic cited a severe drop in sales to two unidentified large customers for the decline in current third quarter sales. The company said it continues to do business with both customers and is hopeful that sales to those customers will improve in the fourth quarter.

"If you examine the operating results before the restructuring charges, you will see that we are making progress toward our goal of returning to profitability," said J. Larry Smart, chairman and chief executive.
For several years, the company had been developing products for the video-on-demand and related markets. In general, the growth of these markets has failed to materialize, the company said.
